messages:
sophia: Quick heads-up — partner launch tomorrow at 16:00 UTC. We're instituting a brief release freeze and a special monitoring posture across infra/model layers. Please read and ack.

deploy-bot: Release freeze window: tomorrow 13:30:30 UTC (1 hour). Services tagged `partner-prod` will be blocked from non-exempt deploys.

mateo (eng): Is the freeze only for production or does staging get it too?

sophia: Production only. Staging test deploys are fine but do not promote without coordinating with @alex.

rana (product): Customer success asked for a last-minute tweak to the routing config. Is that allowed?

alex (release-manager): Minor routing flags that are config-only and low-risk can use the fast-path exemption. Use `/deploy-exempt --service <svc> --env prod --type config --reason "routing tweak for partner" --owner @<you>` and tag `partner-launch`. We'll triage within 20m. No model artifact swaps during the freeze.

kai (sre): Monitoring posture: enable detailed traces for the partner endpoints and bump retention to 48h for logs during the freeze. We'll run short synthetic smoke every 5m. If error rate >0.5% for 3 consecutive checks, we roll back.

tess (customer-success): Thanks. We'll hold the partner on-boarding call at T+30 but may delay if alerts spike.

mateo (eng): For rollback, is it automatic or manual? Any automated rollback safety for model-serving?

alex (release-manager): Auto-rollback enabled for infra and config changes gated by canary checks. For model-serving swaps, no automatic full rollback by default — we require manual confirmation unless you set `auto_rollback=true` in the canary manifest. Recommend conservative canary: 5% for 20m -> 25% for 10m.

sophia: Also adding this into the weekly changelog summary: a lane for "Partner launch hardening" with the freeze window and exemption details. Emily (devex) — feel free to paste.

ops-bot: New audit token: partner-launch-2026-03 created and attached to exemption requests. Audit link: https://redwood.internal/audit/partner-launch-2026-03

rana (product): small request: can we relax the UI deploys that only affect beta-feature flags? They won't touch partner traffic.

alex (release-manager): Beta flags that aren't routed to partner-prod are exempt; include `--affected-targets beta` in the exemption request.

mateo (eng): acked. I'll schedule the encoder latency micro-patch for 11:00 PT so it's out of the way.

kai (sre): Post-freeze checklist: run canary metrics sweep at +15m, +45m, and +120m post-launch. I'll post a link to the dashboard.

sophia: Thanks team. Please reply with ack when you see this. We'll re-evaluate after the post-launch +2h sweep. :rocket:
file_description: partner launch release freeze notice, exemption flow, canary/rollback guidance, and weekly changelog snippet for engineering release train
